sections.heading: $ what_is_this
sections.body: HiveScope Chat is a decentralized chat linked to Hive accounts, built on the Nostr protocol. Every message is a Nostr event, stored by hivescope-relay — there's no company account or password, your identity is a cryptographic key.

sections.heading: $ hive_keychain
sections.body: Hive Keychain is a browser extension (or mobile app) that holds your Hive keys, so you never type a password into this site or any other. You need it installed before you can link an account here — search "Hive Keychain" in your browser's extension store, or install the Hive Keychain mobile app.

sections.heading: $ linking
sections.body: Linking signs a short message once with your Hive posting key, proving you control that account. We never see or store your private key, only that one signature. Each browser/device gets its own separate link — the same Hive account can be linked from several devices at once. The "logout" button forgets this device's link; there's no export/import yet, so logging out is one-way — linking again on this browser creates a new, separate link, not a return to the old one.

sections.heading: $ rooms
sections.body: Any linked account can create a room; whoever creates a given name first becomes its owner. From then on, only that room's owner, the account currently listed as its admin, or the relay's operator account can rename it or hand off admin to someone else — but any linked account can still post in any room, room names aren't reserved for particular people to write in.

sections.heading: $ expiration
sections.body: Whoever creates or edits a room picks how long it lasts (1 hour, 24 hours, 7, 30, or 90 days) — once that time passes with no updates, the room and its messages are removed (cleanup runs every few minutes, so a room can linger a few minutes past its mark). Renaming it, or any other edit, resets the clock from that moment with whatever duration you pick then — there's no separate "renew" action, editing is enough. Each room in the list shows how long it has left, next to its admin.

sections.heading: $ hive_snaps
sections.body: When you create a room, HiveScope also asks Hive Keychain to post a short "snap" about it on Hive — a reply to the daily @peak.snaps thread — so the room gets announced on the blockchain. It's a real, permanent Hive post that can't be deleted, even if the room itself expires in an hour. If you cancel the Keychain popup or the snap fails, the room is still created, you just won't get the announcement.

sections.heading: $ theme
sections.body: Dark (the default) or light, switchable any time with the sun/moon button in the corner — your choice is remembered on this device.

sections.heading: $ privacy
sections.body: Messages are public: they're Nostr events anyone running a Nostr client can read, along with the room name and the pubkey that sent them. This isn't private or encrypted messaging — don't post anything you wouldn't want public.
